integrity: The formula is proved from support classes and unique-neighbor obstructions; finite computation is used only as an independent replay on small field-order patterns.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to direct products of at least three finite fields.
It does not classify all minimum resolving dominating sets.
An equivalent mixed-field formula could exist in an unindexed source under the synonym dominant metric dimension.
title: Resolving domination of zero-divisor graphs for mixed products of finite fields
